dialogue.dialogue: Did you ever hear about what Evil Genius used to do for a living?
Just a few years back, he used to work for Company Inc LLC, designing all the technology they’ve invaded us with.
For a time, he really seemed to like his job– or at least, I think he did??
Anyways, one day, he told me he was having stomach pains and nightmares which made it hard for him to work.
He said that one of the nightmares was about a computer he designed coming alive and doing… something about dead squirrels?
Uh, by that time, he was shaking and crying, so…
I don't really know what that was about.
But whatever it was, he ended up quitting like three days later.
I never really figured out why he did it, but I guess that’s his business…
